description: Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots
summary:
Pyrolog is an advanced geospatial web application designed for comprehensive 
wildfire monitoring, historical trend analysis, and environmental assessment in 
the Amazon region. By harmonizing multi-sensor NASA satellite data—including 
MODIS, Suomi NPP, and live NOAA-20/21 streams—the platform empowers 
researchers and emergency responders with interactive maps, brightness 
indicators, and real-time analytics to tackle wildfire crises efficiently.
details:
Pyrolog bridges the gap between historical fire archives and near-real-time

monitoring while pioneering proactive disaster mitigation. The platform

features an interactive dark-mode dashboard built with Leaflet mapping,

multi-sensor satellite streams (MODIS, Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21),

day/night pass filtering, and multi-year time-series analytics. Crucially, Pyrolog integrates an advanced 'Fire Prevention & Early Warning' module

that analyzes historical multi-year regional patterns, calculates extreme risk

indices, and delivers automated alert systems with actionable mitigation

strategies—such as thermal anomaly early intervention and biomass

management—to stop wildfires before they escalate
